'''Navu''' was a [[Overseer (Sith)|Sith Overseer]] who trained acolytes on the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. They were in contact with [[Darth Norok]], and evidently wish to train some [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] for him, however Norok was not interested and threatened Navu's life if they continued to pester him.<ref name="TOR" />
